entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.UPDATE-NEEDED
entities.description: A substate of 5GMM-REGISTERED where the UE needs to perform registration but is prevented by access barring or connection failures. Only specific procedures can be initiated in this state.

entities.name: Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
entities.description: Registration procedure initiated by the UE for mobility or periodic registration updates.

entities.name: Service request procedure as a response to paging or notification
entities.description: Service request procedure initiated by the UE in response to network paging or notifications.

entities.name: Access barred due to unified access control
entities.description: Condition where UE access is barred due to unified access control in 3GPP access.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection establishment rejected
entities.description: Condition where network rejects N1 NAS signalling connection establishment in 3GPP or non-3GPP access.

entities.name: RRC connection resumption failed with access barred
entities.description: Condition where UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication fails RRC connection resumption and access is barred for categories except '0' and '2'.

entities.name: Only specific procedures allowed
entities.description: Property that only registration procedure for mobility/periodic update and service request procedure as response to paging/notification can be initiated in UPDATE-NEEDED state.

relations.description: State entry is guarded by access barred due to unified access control condition.
State entry is guarded by N1 NAS signalling connection rejection condition.
State entry is guarded by RRC connection resumption failure with access barred condition.
Registration procedure for mobility/periodic update requires UPDATE-NEEDED state.
Service request procedure as response to paging/notification requires UPDATE-NEEDED state.
UPDATE-NEEDED state establishes the property that only specific procedures are allowed.
